DESCRIPTION
Positioned on an upper floor, this attractive two-bedroom apartment at 93 South Quay on Kings Road offers well-proportioned and thoughtfully arranged living space within a highly sought-after residential development. The property is ideally suited to professionals, couples or those seeking a convenient, low-maintenance lifestyle in a desirable waterfront setting.
The apartment benefits from a bright and welcoming living area, designed to maximise natural light and provide a comfortable space for both relaxing and entertaining. The layout flows effortlessly, creating a practical yet modern feel throughout. The kitchen is well-appointed, offering ample storage and workspace to cater to day-to-day living.
Both bedrooms are well-sized, providing comfortable accommodation, while the bathroom is fitted to serve the needs of a modern household. The overall condition of the property allows buyers to move in with ease while enjoying a well-maintained and functional home.
Situated in a popular and well-connected location, South Quay offers close proximity to a range of local amenities, waterfront walks, restaurants and leisure facilities. Excellent transport links and access to Swansea city centre make this an ideal base for those looking to balance convenience with scenic surroundings.
